name: HYDRA-UMC-VISUAL-SERVOING-API
notes: Established v0: real Position-Based Visual Servoing (PBVS) correction law - pose-delta computation with shortest-turn angle wrapping, proportional velocity command with direction-preserving clamping, and convergence check, exposed via the 'correct' subcommand. Plus a safety-gated authorization layer (authorization.py) that refuses to turn a visual detection into motion unless the upstream safety_state is READY and the data is confident/fresh enough (INHIBITED wins over REJECTED, mirroring HYDRA-UMC-SAFETY-ZONES), exposed via the 'request' subcommand. Added hailo_runtime.py: a real HailoRT (hailo_platform) integration boundary - open_vdevice()/load_hailo_pose_model() against the real confirmed API, lazily imported so this dev machine (no hailort installed) degrades to a clear RuntimeError; hailo_output_to_pose() adapts a real InferVStreams result into this project's own Pose6D and is fully unit-tested without hailort. 57 tests. Real 6-DOF pose *estimation* (needs the Hailo-8 NPU and a real compiled .hef) and the low-latency gRPC feed to the HYDRA-UMC core remain future work.
